claims.statement: Muay Thai uses eight points of contact (fists, elbows, knees, shins) plus clinch work; taekwondo focuses on kicks with limited punching, mainly to the torso.
claims.allowed_wording: Règles World Taekwondo et IFMA (sources officielles/Wikipedia).
claims.limits: Décrire les règles de compétition, pas « le taekwondo est inutile ».

claims.statement: IFMA is fully recognised by the IOC since 2021.
claims.allowed_wording: « IFMA is a fully recognised federation of the IOC since 2021 » (olympics.com, officiel).
claims.limits: Ne pas suggérer une présence aux JO.

claims.statement: Taekwondo became an official Olympic sport at the 2000 Sydney Games (demonstration earlier).
Taekwondo originated in Korea in the mid-20th century; Muay Thai has Thai origins with a ritual layer (wai kru, ram muay).
claims.allowed_wording: Sources de référence ; formulation prudente sur l'histoire.
claims.limits: Ne pas trancher les controverses d'origine.

claims.statement: Wildcat teaches Muay Thai and does not teach taekwondo.
